# Retrospective

## What worked

- Bounded security triage included the directly linked issue and relevant instruction/test files before technical launches.
- Fresh Claude Code Opus 5.5 High and Pi GPT 6 Sol Xhigh sessions were verified without reusing prior conclusions. Both independent reports existed before either was read.
- The small source change and complete notification helper resolved the important questions without unnecessary synthetic or native runtime work.
- Public feedback stays proportionate: source-only no-findings outcome, small before/after comparison, explicit delivery/testing limits. Cosmetic glyph history remains local.
- Raw API envelopes were retained separately from decoded source, stderr and producer status.

## Avoidable friction and deviations

See PROCESS-DEVIATIONS.md. A policy-tail read used Bash rather than read, and Herdr guidance was returned in one over-60-line response. It was read fully, not truncated. More importantly, an accidental empty write created the sibling ` pr-12670-ignore` file outside the assignment root. It is preserved. No runtime, technical source, session independence or public evidence was affected. Future artifact calls must use a single prevalidated assignment-root join; do not manually type ad hoc artifact destinations. Subsequent outputs stayed within this root except explicitly authorized launcher state. The final-package writer now asserts each resolved output is beneath the assignment root. Future command-produced guidance must be saved to a validated local path and read in bounded chunks. Completion marks safety_process_compliant false rather than hiding the incident.

## Resource and tooling notes

No runtime fixtures, desktop nests or child services were created. No cleanup was required beyond leaving reviewer processes idle. No confirmed toolkit defect or resource blocker was encountered. No Claude quota signal occurred. No persistent reviewer memory was intentionally edited. Native session history is preserved in its normal storage.

## Carry forward

Source inspection is sufficient for narrow argument and redirection fixes when every relevant helper path is inspectable. Avoid converting an unexecuted test design assessment into a runtime claim. History research can explain a typo, but cosmetic alternatives need not enlarge a clean public review. Preserve private process corrections locally and keep the editorial inputs limited to the exact draft and immutable requirements.
comment:
**Verified by source inspection:** No actionable defect found in the change at `5d39d9f`. Both Ghostty and Foot restart reminders now pass a headline and body to `omarchy-notification-send`, and the process checks suppress PID output without changing their match conditions.

| Path | Before | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Process check | Matching PIDs reach stdout | Output redirected |
| Restart reminder | `-g` consumes the message, leaving no headline | Separate headline/body reach the D-Bus call |

The new regression test targets both failures through the real setter and notification wrapper with stubbed process checks and D-Bus transport. Its summary/body argument indices match the wrapper's call construction.
